name: Customer
description: A customer — a consumer of the services or products offered by the QuickBooks company.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object, assigned by QuickBooks. Required (along with SyncToken) for update, and required for read/delete.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. System-assigned and maintained for optimistic concurrency; not authored by the caller but must be echoed back (with Id) on every update operation.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description: The name of the customer as displayed. Must be unique across all Customer, Vendor, and Employee objects. Conditionally required: supply DisplayName, or at least one of Title/GivenName/MiddleName/FamilyName/Suffix from which it is derived. Max 500 characters.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Title of the person. Not supported for companies. Used as part of the name; max 16 characters.

fields.name: GivenName
fields.description: Given (first) name of the person. Max 100 characters. At least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix is required for a person if DisplayName is not supplied.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the person. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: FamilyName
fields.description: Family (last) name of the person. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: Suffix
fields.description: Suffix of the name of the person (e.g. Jr, Sr). Max 16 characters.

fields.name: CompanyName
fields.description: The name of the company associated with the customer. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: FullyQualifiedName
fields.description: Fully qualified name of the object; the DisplayName prefixed with the names of any parent (job) customers, colon-delimited. System generated.

fields.name: PrintOnCheckName
fields.description: Name of the customer as printed on a check. Max 110 characters.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: If true, this entity is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks. Defaults to true.

fields.name: Job
fields.description: If true, this is a Job (sub-customer) rather than a top-level customer. Default is false.

fields.name: BillWithParent
fields.description: If true, this Customer object is billed with its parent (only applies to sub-customers/jobs that have a ParentRef).

fields.name: Level
fields.description: Specifies the level of the hierarchy in which the entity is located. Zero for the top-level customer; sub-customers increment. System generated.

fields.name: Taxable
fields.description: If true, transactions for this customer are taxable. Default behavior depends on company sales-tax configuration.

fields.name: ResaleNum
fields.description: Resale number or other identifier for tax-exempt purchases. Max 16 characters.

fields.name: PreferredDeliveryMethod
fields.description: Preferred delivery method for sending forms/transactions to this customer.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Free-form text notes about the customer. Max 2000 characters.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: Specifies the open balance amount or the amount unpaid by the customer. Calculated by QuickBooks; read-only on update. May be set only at create to specify an opening balance (paired with OpenBalanceDate).

fields.name: BalanceWithJobs
fields.description: Cumulative open balance amount for the Customer (or Job) and all its sub-jobs. System generated.

fields.name: OpenBalanceDate
fields.description: Date of the open balance, used when setting an initial opening balance at create time (paired with the Balance amount).

fields.name: PrimaryTaxIdentifier
fields.description: Tax ID of the customer (for international/region-specific use). Available for non-US regions.

fields.name: SecondaryTaxIdentifier
fields.description: Secondary tax ID of the customer (region specific). Available for non-US regions.

fields.name: GSTIN
fields.description: GST registration number of the customer (India region).

fields.name: GSTRegistrationType
fields.description: GST registration type (India region).

fields.name: BusinessNumber
fields.description: Business number / company registration identifier (region specific, e.g. ABN for AU, BN for CA).

fields.name: IsProject
fields.description: If true, indicates this customer entity represents a Project. System managed.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: Indicates the originating source of the customer record (e.g. QBCommerce). System set.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method in which tax is applied for transactions of this customer. Applicable for non-US/CA companies with sales tax enabled.

fields.name: TaxExemptionReasonId
fields.description: The tax exemption reason identifier associated with the customer (US automated sales tax). Numeric id supplied as a string; corresponds to a documented tax-exemption reason code.

fields.name: PrimaryPhone
fields.description: Primary phone number of the customer.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the telephone number in free-form. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: AlternatePhone
fields.description: Alternate phone number of the customer.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the telephone number in free-form. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: Mobile
fields.description: Mobile phone number of the customer.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the telephone number in free-form. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: Fax
fields.description: Fax number of the customer.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the telephone number in free-form. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: PrimaryEmailAddr
fields.description: Primary email address of the customer.

attributes.name: Address
attributes.description: An email address. Must contain '@' and '.'. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: WebAddr
fields.description: Website address of the customer.

attributes.name: URI
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Identifier for the website. Max 1000 characters.

fields.name: BillAddr
fields.description: Default billing address of the customer.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the address object, assigned by QuickBooks.

attributes.name: Line1
attributes.description: First line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line2
attributes.description: Second line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line3
attributes.description: Third line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line4
attributes.description: Fourth line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line5
attributes.description: Fifth line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: City name. Max 255 characters.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country (e.g. state in USA, province in Canada). Max 255 characters.

attributes.name: PostalCode
attributes.description: Postal/ZIP code. Max 30 characters.

attributes.name: Country
attributes.description: Country name. Max 255 characters.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of geocoded address. System generated.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of geocoded address. System generated.

fields.name: ShipAddr
fields.description: Default shipping address of the customer.

fields.name: ParentRef
fields.description: A reference to the parent Customer when this entity is a sub-customer (Job). Required when the customer is a job/sub-customer.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced parent Customer object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced parent Customer.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts associated with this customer are expressed. Settable only at create if multicurrency is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name of the currency.

fields.name: SalesTermRef
fields.description: Reference to a default sales Term (payment terms) associated with this customer.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Term object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Term.

fields.name: PaymentMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to a PaymentMethod associated with this customer.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced PaymentMethod object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced PaymentMethod.

fields.name: DefaultTaxCodeRef
fields.description: Reference to the default TaxCode for transactions of this customer (automated sales tax / tax-enabled companies).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

fields.name: ARAccountRef
fields.description: Reference to the Accounts Receivable account associated with this customer.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account.

fields.name: CustomerTypeRef
fields.description: Reference to the CustomerType assigned to this customer.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced CustomerType object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced CustomerType.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive metadata about the object, maintained by QuickBooks.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain the object belongs to; constant value QBO. System generated.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: When set to true on an update request, performs a sparse update — only the supplied fields are modified, all others retained. Echoed in responses.
